title: Decision tree paths and DNF evaluation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ coordinates with outputs in $\{ -1,1\}$. For every sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, its associated disjunctive normal form evaluates to $-1$ at $x$ if and only if there is a path in $T$ ending at output $-1$ whose prescribed coordinate values agree with the binary vector corresponding to $x$ under the coordinatewise bijection between $\mathbb{F}_2$ and $\{-1,1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: Tree $T$ on $n$ coordinates with sign outputs
